name: Gamble Sands

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP elevation service (3DEPElevation ImageServer exportImage, 1 m, EPSG:32611, box x 301500-303400 / y 5325700-5328600); the 1 m DEM under the course is WA_NorthCentral_2021_B21 (tile x30y533, flown 2021-08-25 to 2022-05-22, published 2024-06-15, per the service's identify); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-gamble_sands, usgs_dem_m.tif)

laz.source: USGS Lidar Point Cloud WA_NorthCentral_2021_B21 (WA_NorthCentral_2_2021), 6 tiles from rockyweb.usgs.gov, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-gamble_sands), each clipped to the world + 100 m by intake.py laz; NAD83(2011) / UTM 11N, NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres. The project ends at x 302246 (EPSG:32611): the east part of the course has no lidar; classes 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures), 2 ground, 7 noise: no vegetation classes
laz.label: 2021 USGS North Central Washington lidar

ortho.source: USDA NAIP from the USGS National Map NAIP ImageServer (exportImage, about 0.6 m, EPSG:32611), two JPEG exports placed by their request boxes (intake.py ortho); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-gamble_sands)

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 876550790, 1,287 x 2,143 m in EPSG:32611) + 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred. 2,560 m north-south is over the 2,048 m guideline (COURSE_BUILD.md 6.1): the boundary alone is 2,143 m tall.

scorecard_source: The club's printed scorecard (dated 07/24), photographed and sent by the developer 2026-11-13: Medal 7,151 yd 73.4/120, Back 6,664 70.7/114, Sands 6,389 69.4/111, Regular 6,113 (m 68.6/109, l 73.9/120), Intermediate 5,623 (m 66.0/103, l 70.9/113), Forward 4,804 66.4/102; par and handicap rows; every row adds up to its total. Same as GolfPass. Local rules on the card: all sandy areas are played as waste areas (through the green); all desert areas are red penalty areas, their edge where grass and desert meet (Model Local Rule B-1). OSM's hole lines tag 5, 11, 13 and 14 with other pars (the card is used).
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (WA North Central 2021 lidar)
Imagery check: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP)
rough_band_note: a thin band of mown rough along the fairways, then the sand, sage and bunchgrass of the native ground (theme F tones)

gorse.note: sagebrush and rabbitbrush, not gorse: bushes from the NAIP photo (pipeline/gorse.py; dark scrub on the pale sand), 7 m apart, kept 3 m off mown grass; no penal ground (bushes only, as at Pronghorn and Silvies); drawn by the theme's steppe_bush painter

waste_sand_note: the card's local rule: all sandy areas at Gamble Sands are played as waste areas. Every OSM bunker is tagged sand=waste in edits.json (s08: surface 18, general area)
